findings.evidence: 1. Read the provided JSON/YAML; ask for the file only if absent.
findings.fix: Drop the ask-for-file clause (default agent behavior); keep the version and paths checks, which are the non-obvious part

findings.evidence: Detect collisions before emission; disambiguate deterministically with parameter or status/media suffixes and state the rule.
findings.fix: Give one collision example with the exact emitted names (e.g. two GET /users/{id} operations → GetUserById and GetUserByIdQueryParams) so the suffix rule is unambiguous

findings.evidence: `oneOf` maps to a union, `allOf` generally to an intersection, and enums to literal unions.
findings.fix: Add the missing environment gotchas: oneOf without a discriminator field, and readOnly/writeOnly asymmetry between request and response types
For large specs, summarize planned type names before writing (or support a dry run) so a naming collision does not produce a full-file rewrite
Add evals for recursive $ref guards (cycle safety) and operationId collisions — both rule-heavy paths no eval covers
State the empty-schemas branch explicitly: emit only operation types and report zero named schemas, so the agent is not left guessing
